summary: The diff implements all three requirements (REQ-1, REQ-2, REQ-3) for the professional profile layout with uploadable banner and photo. ProfilePage.tsx is redesigned with the banner, overlapping circular avatar, dark golden name box, handle, and stats row. Supporting hooks (useGetBannerImage, useSetBannerImage, useUpdateProfilePhoto) are added in useQueries.ts. Backend migration and main.mo updates rename 'profilePicture' to 'profilePhoto'. The implementation appears comprehensive and aligned with the build request.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend data migration module (migration.mo) that renames the 'profilePicture' field to 'profilePhoto' with a full migration runner
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request only asked to reuse existing backend blob storage endpoints; no field renaming or migration was requested. The constraints said 'Reuse existing backend blob storage endpoints for banner and profile photo uploads' without any mention of a schema migration.
